instruction:
The CAE work moves through two software stages: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. Use the SOLIDWORKS 2025 and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop for the two stages of this workflow. Start from a blank SolidWorks part and use N-mm-MPa units.

Handoff requirement: preserve EW_SW_ABQ_09 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS in the STEP text, and preserve EW_SW_ABQ_09 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step in a native Abaqus name or job description.

1. In SolidWorks, create one connected stiffened panel solid. The base occupies 0<=X<=160 mm, 0<=Y<=70 mm, 0<=Z<=2 mm. Add two longitudinal rectangular ribs spanning the full X length: rib 1 occupies 22<=Y<=26 mm and rib 2 occupies 44<=Y<=48 mm; both occupy 2<=Z<=5 mm. Export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. Import the exact one-cell STEP solid into Model-StiffenedPanelBuckle and keep it as a 3D solid idealization; do not replace it with an unrelated shell. Define Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3 and assign a homogeneous solid section. Use a coarse first-order C3D4/C3D8R mesh with no quadratic elements and no more than 1000 nodes. Create FIXED_EDGE from the complete merged X=0 end face, including the base and both rib ends. Create LOAD_EDGE and LOAD_EDGE_SURFACE from the corresponding complete merged X=160 end face. Create linear perturbation buckle step Step-Buckle requesting exactly 5 eigenvalues. Apply BC-FixedEdge with U1=U2=U3=0. Create a reference point at (160,35,2.5) mm, connect it to LOAD_EDGE_SURFACE with distributing coupling Coupling-LoadEdge, and apply Load-Compression400N as the unique reference load CF1=-400 N. Submit Job-StiffenedPanelBuckle and wait for completion.
3. Required Desktop deliverables: stage1_geometry.step, Job-StiffenedPanelBuckle.cae, and Job-StiffenedPanelBuckle.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.
